people.name: Paul
people.line: Apostle to the Gentiles, author of many NT epistles

translations.web: They threw him out of the city and stoned him. The witnesses placed their garments at the feet of a young man named Saul.
translations.bsb: They dragged him out of the city and began to stone him. Meanwhile the witnesses laid their garments at the feet of a young man named Saul.
translations.kjv: And cast him out of the city, and stoned him: and the witnesses laid down their clothes at a young man's feet, whose name was Saul.
translations.asv: and they cast him out of the city, and stoned him: and the witnesses laid down their garments at the feet of a young man named Saul.
